complaint-callback.name: Complaint Callback
complaint-callback.description: List open complaints from their log and attach named photos if present.

extra-work-auth-list.name: Extra Work Auth List
extra-work-auth-list.description: Match add-on, extra-day, and project rows on the schedule to an auth PDF in the contract folder.

holiday-coverage.name: Holiday Coverage
holiday-coverage.description: Read their holiday calendar against the schedule and roster.

key-log-completeness.name: Key Log Completeness
key-log-completeness.description: Match issued key-ids on the key log to sites on the site list.

missed-service-list.name: Missed Service List
missed-service-list.description: List schedule rows they coded as missed and any complaint rows that point at a miss.

night-board.name: Night Board
night-board.description: Build a night list from their site list, schedule CSV, and crew roster.

quality-checklist-pack.name: Quality Checklist Pack
quality-checklist-pack.description: Assemble their quality form and any photo index they stored for the walk.

sds-index-missing.name: SDS Index Missing
sds-index-missing.description: Compare chemical names on the par sheet to the SDS index.

supply-below-par.name: Supply Below Par
supply-below-par.description: Compare on-hand to their par or min on the supply par sheet.
